001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation;
002
003/**
004 * Provides the version information of Rainbow Gum as static literals.
005 */
006public final class RainbowGumVersion {
007        private RainbowGumVersion() {
008        }
009        /**
010         * Rainbow Gum Version.
011         */
012        public static final String VERSION = "0.11.0";
013
014        /**
015         * Resolves the Rainbow Gum documentation URL based on {@link #VERSION}.
016         * @return URL <strong>with no trailing slash!</strong>
017         */
018        public static String documentBaseUrl() {
019                String version = VERSION;
020                if (version.endsWith("-SNAPSHOT")) {
021                        return "https://jstach.io/rainbowgum";
022                }
023                return "https://jstach.io/doc/rainbowgum/" + version + "/apidocs";
024        }
025}
